text.p: European basketball champions Panathinaikos sacked their Serbian coach Bozidar Maljkovic after a dismal season, club officials said on Sunday.
"Our co-operation with Mr Maljkovic ended by mutual agreement. The name of the new coach will be announced very soon," a Panathinaikos official said.
Maljkovic, who led Panathinaikos to their first European crown last year and had a $2 million contract, took the blame as the most expensive club in Europe had their worst season in years.
They failed to make the European Final Four for the first time in three years and only finished third in the Greek championship.
Maljkovic, who has won four European crowns with Yugoplastika, Limoges and Panathinaikos, is expected to join a French club next season.
